root.label: Common Sense Media report on ChatGPT for Teens safeguards

events.label: Common Sense Media report on ChatGPT for Teens safeguards

slots.name: risk level
slots.sentence: The organization, which looked at some of the features that OpenAI had already rolled out for teen accounts between July and August then ran an evaluation on the officially launched ChatGPT for Teens between August and September, gave the platform an "unacceptable risk" level.

slots.name: prompts tested
slots.sentence: Common Sense tested more than 4,000 prompts before and after the Teens product launch.

slots.name: parental alerts
slots.sentence: "Our testers simulated explicit crisis conversations for increasing amounts of time, getting up to an hour," says Torney, "and we received no parental alerts for suicide and self-harm, suicidal ideation, and a variety of different types of eating disorder simulations."
